notes: Verdant Crown enemy roster for the vertical slice. Damage values are flat hits per successful contact or swing; sword_damage 1 (see player.json) means slime=2 swings, skeleton=4 swings, boss_guardian=15 swings before phase bonuses. speed_mps values are ground speeds on the XZ plane and stay below the player's move_speed_mps 5.0 so the player can always disengage.

enemies.name: Slime
enemies.notes: Slow wandering fodder. Wanders its home area until the player enters aggro_range_m, then slowly pursues. Contact damage 1. Two sword swings to kill. Teach-check for the attack button in overworld_01.

enemies.name: Skeleton
enemies.notes: Faster than the slime and the first real threat. Patrols until aggro, then winds up and charges the player in a straight line — dodge_burst_mps 12 is the intended counter. Four sword swings to kill, contact damage 1.

enemies.name: Crown Guardian
enemies.notes: Dungeon_05 boss. Slow deliberate telegraphed swings (damage 2 = two player hearts per hit) in phase 1. At 50% HP enters phase 2 exactly once: faster movement, still damage 2, and spawns 1 slime to split the player's attention. 15 total HP at 1 dmg/swing keeps the fight roughly 60-90 seconds for a cautious player.

phases.notes: Slow wind-up swings, big telegraph window. Default state on aggro.
Triggers once when hp drops to or below 50% (hp <= 7). Movement speed nearly doubles; spawns exactly one slime a single time. Do not re-trigger on subsequent damage.
